title: The Spire of the Ninefold Court Anew
premise: When the border wards between the mortal city of Greyhollow and the Ninefold Court collapse, bone-carver Felix Dunmore discovers his gift for hearing the dead is the last living thread of an ancient covenant — one the Court's dying spire needs reforged before the realms bleed into each other. Hunted by wardens who outlawed his magic and guided by a found family of exiles, a disgraced warden, and a half-fae smuggler, Felix learns the covenant demands a life freely given. In the end, the dead he has always heard give theirs instead, the spire relights, and Felix chooses Greyhollow — and his new family — over a place in the Court.
about_author: Zephyrine Almeida is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing funerary carvings in coastal graveyards before turning to fiction. They write fantasy about grief, craft, and the stubborn families we build when the world refuses to hold us.

chapters.title: Charms for the Quiet Dead
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. In Greyhollow, Felix sells bone charms and quietly answers the dead who whisper through them, hiding his gift from the warden patrols that outlawed magic. When an old woman's charm begs him to 'mend what was broken,' the border wards shatter and every star vanishes at once. Emotional beat: lonely competence cracking into dread.

chapters.title: The Night Without Stars
chapters.summary: Felix's POV, with a brief warden-captain Isolde Vane section. The city panics under a starless sky as creatures of the Court slip through the fallen wards. Isolde arrests Felix for the surge of magic she traced to his shop — but the dead mob her senses too, and she realizes he's the only one who can hear what's coming. Emotional beat: fear becoming uneasy alliance.

chapters.title: The Smuggler's Toll
chapters.summary: Half-fae smuggler Rook Ashvane's POV. Rook agrees — for a price — to guide Felix and Isolde through the smugglers' tunnels into the Court, hiding her own stake: her exiled mother's name is carved in the spire. Emotional beat: guarded transactional trust, the first stitch of found family.

chapters.title: What the Spire Remembers
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. Crossing into the Court, Felix touches the darkened spire and hears its memory: the covenant was sealed by nine voices, mortal and fae alike, and it broke when mortals outlawed magic and the Court stopped answering. One voice is still faintly alive — and it knows his name. Emotional beat: awe curdling into personal stakes.

chapters.title: The Court of Ash and Courtesy
chapters.summary: Rook's POV. The survivors of the Ninefold Court receive them with beautiful, poisonous hospitality. Rook bargains with the Court's regent, learning the spire can be reforged only by a covenant-voice — and the regent intends that voice to be Rook's mother, held in stasis. Emotional beat: longing and resentment toward a parent who chose exile.

chapters.title: Warden's Confession
chapters.summary: Isolde's POV. Isolde reveals her order didn't just outlaw magic — her mentor broke the covenant deliberately, believing the Court fed on mortal grief, and the wardens have been siphoning the spire's light for years. Torn between loyalty and truth, she burns her warden seal. Emotional beat: guilt transmuted into resolve.

chapters.title: The Price Written in Bone
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. The spire's living voice shows Felix the covenant's terms: it must be reforged with a life freely given, and it has chosen him. The dead he's carried for years — including the old woman's charm — begin teaching him how, each lesson costing warmth he can't replace. Emotional beat: the weight of survival, and choosing to pay anyway.

chapters.title: Regent's Gambit
chapters.summary: Rook's POV. The regent moves to force Rook's mother into the covenant instead, and the Court fractures into factions. Rook, Felix, and Isolde stage a desperate rescue through the spire's root-vaults, and Rook finally speaks to her mother — who begs to be let go. Emotional beat: grief accepted, family redefined.

chapters.title: The Reforging
chapters.summary: Climax. Felix's POV. At the spire's heart, Felix begins the reforging as the regent attacks and the sky over both realms tears. At the final word, the dead rise — every voice Felix ever carried — and give themselves freely in his place. The spire relights; stars return; the regent is unmade by the light she hoarded. Emotional beat: sacrifice witnessed, terror becoming grace.

chapters.title: Nine Voices, One Home
chapters.summary: Resolution, rotating POVs. The covenant remade, the Court opens a lawful gate; Isolde rebuilds the wardens as keepers rather than hunters, and Rook ferries between realms with her mother's name finally at peace. Felix returns to Greyhollow, reopens his shop, and carves a new charm that holds nine small voices — family, not ghosts. Emotional beat: belonging chosen, quiet and earned.
